<article title="Order tracking">
You can follow your order from the Orders page of your account. Once a package leaves our warehouse, the order shows a carrier name and a tracking number, and the carrier's page updates within 24 hours of the first scan.

If the tracking page has not updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub. In that case we can open a trace with the carrier; a trace usually resolves within five business days.

Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave the warehouse the same day. Orders placed later, or on weekends, leave the next business day.

</article>

Customer first name: Grace
<request>
send everything to my new place
i moved. how do i make sure the order i placed yesterday goes to the new address?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Grace,

Thanks for reaching out. Our article covers tracking, but it doesn't explain how to change a shipping address on an order that's already placed, so I can't confirm whether that's possible for yesterday's order. A specialist will follow up with you on that.

What I can tell you: orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave our warehouse the same day, and later orders or weekend orders leave the next business day. Once your package ships, you can follow it from the Orders page in your account, where the carrier and tracking number will appear.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
